requirements.title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
requirements.description: Executive dashboard with KPIs, revenue forecast, sales rep leaderboard, and pipeline conversion funnel

requirements.title: Custom Reporting
requirements.description: Drag-and-drop report builder, scheduled report delivery, report sharing, and cross-object reporting

requirements.title: Activity Analytics and Performance Tracking
requirements.description: Sales activity metrics, response time analytics, and best time to contact analysis

requirements.title: Data Modeling and Integration
requirements.description: Data model to support sales analytics, custom reports, and activity analytics, with integration of leads, contacts, deals, and activities

requirements.title: Security and Access Control
requirements.description: Role-based access control for report sharing and data access

requirements.title: Data Model and Entity Relationship Management
requirements.description: Design and implementation of the CRM's data model including entities like Lead, Contact, Company, Deal, Activity, Pipeline, and EmailThread, with their respective fields and relationships.

requirements.title: Search and Indexing Capability
requirements.description: Implementation of Elasticsearch indices for full-text search with fuzzy matching and highlighting, real-time index updates, and search suggestions.

requirements.title: Multi-tenancy and Data Partitioning
requirements.description: Implementation of a multi-tenant architecture with row-level security policies for tenant isolation, and data partitioning for efficient storage and retrieval.

requirements.title: Workflow and Activity Management
requirements.description: Design and implementation of workflow and activity management features to support sales and customer relationship management processes.

requirements.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture
requirements.description: Supports 10,000+ concurrent users with a scalable and secure architecture

requirements.title: Unified Sales Workflow
requirements.description: Integrate with external services to provide a unified sales workflow

requirements.title: API Gateway Architecture
requirements.description: Design an API gateway to manage integration with external services

requirements.title: Integration Platform Architecture
requirements.description: Design and implementation of the overall integration platform, including email, calendar, and third-party integrations

requirements.title: Security and Authentication
requirements.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 for custom integrations and REST API security

requirements.title: Workflow Automation and Notifications
requirements.description: Automation of workflows through Zapier, webhooks, and Slack integration for deal alerts and updates

requirements.title: Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: The system must support high-performance and scalability, including fast page loads, search results, and data processing, as well as handling a large number of concurrent users and data storage

requirements.title: Security and Compliance
requirements.description: The system must ensure security and compliance with major standards and regulations, including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA, and provide features like SSO, MFA, and RBAC

requirements.title: Architecture and Availability
requirements.description: The system must have a robust architecture with high availability, including multi-region deployment, data residency options, and automatic failover, as well as a high system uptime SLA and reliable integrations

requirements.title: Data Management
requirements.description: The system must provide efficient data management, including data storage, processing, and retrieval, as well as data backup and recovery capabilities

requirements.title: Integration and API Reliability
requirements.description: The system must provide reliable integrations with external services, including email providers and webhook delivery, with features like retry mechanisms and HMAC-SHA256 signature

requirements.title: Contact Management
requirements.description: A system for managing contacts, including contact details, activity timelines, and related contacts

requirements.title: Lead and Deal Management
requirements.description: The system should be able to manage leads and deals, including lead qualification, assignment, and conversion, as well as deal stage management and progression

requirements.title: Automated Email and Workflow
requirements.description: The system should be able to automate email sequences and workflows, including email personalization, tracking, and follow-up tasks

requirements.title: Reporting and Analytics
requirements.description: The system should be able to provide custom reporting and analytics capabilities, including data visualization, filtering, and scheduled report delivery

requirements.title: User Interface and Experience
requirements.description: The system should have an intuitive and user-friendly interface, including features such as drag-and-drop report building, real-time tracking, and personalized email templates
